title: Another dream of mine ai gen pic
content: I have another dream that is reoccurring. It’s a more unsettling one, but I’m always in a room a small room with a poker table. There’s four men they don’t have faces, but I can almost feel them staring at me. There’s always a red light gleaming from underneath the door and there’s an old I wanna say like a record player but it’s like the one with the gold looking tuba on it lol but it’s playing this like opera song on repeat and I’m always really uncomfortable in the dream and then it almost sounds like thunder and a flash of light, and then the men at the table ( I’ll keep this pg ) but after the flash of the light, they’re all faced down on the table and I don’t feel their presence anymore, but in unnerving feeling to just run there’s only one door in the whole room the one with the red light coming underneath it which then leads to a hallway that is completely pitch black with a very limited light at the end of the hallway, but the more you run down the hallway the longer it gets and you keep just feeling like you need to run because something‘s coming and it’s almost like the further you run away the more distorted the record starts to sound, but curious if anyone else has had that similar experience or been in the same places as me as well
